decisions.reason: The modular plant concept shows a quantified customer saving of more than 600,000 euros per year, which exceeds aspirations, and the growing, investing firm has the slack to keep developing it.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own dedicated page, which signals strategic commitment, and nothing indicates a shortfall that would prompt search for alternatives.
This modular concept is only mentioned and has no reported results, so its performance is uncertain, but a growing firm with R&D slack can carry it while it fits the modular strategy.
The trommel screen is a close extension of the established mobile range in a growing industry, and with no evidence of underperformance there is no trigger for problemistic search.
